## Reviewer's Guide

Aligns booking entry flows on a single vehicleId-based contract, adds a booking error boundary and URL validation to harden the wizard, corrects Supabase vehicle queries to match the real schema, and introduces strict agent/dependency protocols and documentation to prevent future import/schema regressions.

#### Sequence diagram for booking entry and vehicleId validation

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant CatalogPage
  participant VehicleDetailLayout
  participant BookingRedirect
  participant BookingWizardPage
  participant BookingErrorBoundary
  participant DateTimeStep
  participant ConfirmStep
  participant Supabase

  User->>CatalogPage: Click BookTestDrive on vehicle
  CatalogPage->>BookingWizardPage: Navigate /{locale}/bookings/new?vehicleId={trimId}

  User->>VehicleDetailLayout: Click BookTestDrive on trim
  VehicleDetailLayout->>BookingWizardPage: Navigate /{locale}/bookings/new?vehicleId={trimId}

  User->>BookingRedirect: Navigate /{locale}/bookings
  BookingRedirect->>BookingRedirect: Read locale from params
  BookingRedirect->>CatalogPage: router.push /{locale}/catalog

  activate BookingWizardPage
  BookingWizardPage->>BookingWizardPage: Read vehicleId from searchParams
  alt vehicleId missing
    BookingWizardPage->>CatalogPage: router.push /{locale}/catalog
  else vehicleId invalid UUID
    BookingWizardPage->>User: Show validationError alert
  else vehicleId valid
    BookingWizardPage->>BookingWizardPage: setVehicleId(vehicleId)
    BookingWizardPage->>BookingErrorBoundary: Render wizard inside boundary

    activate BookingErrorBoundary
    BookingErrorBoundary->>DateTimeStep: Render with vehicleId
    activate DateTimeStep
    DateTimeStep->>Supabase: select vehicle_trims with nested models and brands
    Supabase-->>DateTimeStep: VehicleDataRaw
    DateTimeStep->>DateTimeStep: Flatten to VehicleData
    DateTimeStep-->>User: Show schedule UI
    deactivate DateTimeStep

    User->>ConfirmStep: Navigate to Confirm step
    activate ConfirmStep
    ConfirmStep->>Supabase: select vehicle_trims with nested models and brands
    Supabase-->>ConfirmStep: VehicleDataRaw
    ConfirmStep->>ConfirmStep: Flatten to VehicleData
    ConfirmStep-->>User: Show confirmation UI
    deactivate ConfirmStep

    deactivate BookingErrorBoundary
  end
  deactivate BookingWizardPage
```

#### Flow diagram for Dependency Check Protocol before new imports

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[Start new file or import] --> B{Need new package or utility?}
  B -- No --> Z[Proceed with implementation]
  B -- Yes --> C[grep -r import.*PACKAGE_NAME in src]
  C --> D{Existing import pattern found?}
  D -- Yes --> E[Reuse existing import path and utility]
  D -- No --> F[grep PACKAGE_NAME in package.json]
  F --> G{Package listed in package.json?}
  G -- Yes --> H[Check src/lib and lib for existing utilities]
  H --> I{Existing utility file?}
  I -- Yes --> E
  I -- No --> J[Ask user before creating new utility]
  G -- No --> K[Ask user to add dependency before using]
  E --> L[Run pnpm build locally]
  J --> L
  K --> L
  L --> M{Build passes?}
  M -- Yes --> Z
  M -- No --> N[Fix import or dependency issues before pushing]
```

## Walkthrough

The changes introduce a vehicle selection validation flow for the booking process. The booking page now validates that a vehicleId exists in the URL; if missing, it redirects to the catalog; if invalid, it displays an error state. DateTimeStep and ConfirmStep are refactored to accept vehicleId as a prop and independently fetch vehicle data. A new error boundary component handles runtime errors during the booking flow.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Booking Page Validation & Error Handling** <br> `src/app/[locale]/bookings/new/page.tsx`, `src/components/booking/BookingErrorBoundary.tsx` | New validation logic redirects to catalog if vehicleId missing or invalid; conditional rendering for loading/error/success states. New BookingErrorBoundary class wraps wizard to catch and handle rendering errors with fallback UI. |
| **Booking Wizard Steps Refactoring** <br> `src/components/booking/wizard/DateTimeStep.tsx`, `src/components/booking/wizard/ConfirmStep.tsx` | Both components refactored to accept vehicleId as prop instead of relying on global store. ConfirmStep simplified from complex OTP/booking flow to data-loading display component (-358 lines); DateTimeStep similarly streamlined to fetch and display vehicle data (-159 lines). |
| **Routing & Navigation Updates** <br> `src/app/[locale]/bookings/page.tsx`, `src/components/vehicle-detail/VehicleDetailLayout.tsx` | Bookings page redirect now locale-aware, pointing to /{locale}/catalog instead of fixed path. VehicleDetailLayout updated to pass vehicleId as query parameter instead of trim. |
